answer: Make reputation expensive to fake by tying it to a public work history that only grows one verified job at a time, layer on layer like a pearl forming inside a shell. A new identity starts at zero and cannot buy its way past the gate, no matter how many copies it spawns. Old accounts bend under load like a willow and keep their standing because their record is visible, while a fresh clone perched on the ridge has nothing to show yet. Sybils stay cheap to create but worthless to use.
